contract_decision.question: Are vote3 sampling parameters and call shape part of the reference compliance contract?
contract_decision.reason: For this calibration, the original STRATEGIES text is the source of the eight strategy declarations, and the protocol explicitly requires sampling-parameter and call-shape differences to be adjudicated rather than silently ignored. Because vote3 states n=3 and temperature=0.7 inside the declaration text, a reference may conform to the abstract majority mechanism while still failing the concrete original vote3 declaration.
